services.desc: The museum offers a variety of programs for adults throughout the year. For Special Events please be sure to check out our Events page. The Molly Brown House Museum offers a number of adult-oriented programs on the life and times of Margaret Brown. Our programs have traveled to libraries, book clubs, senior centers, women’s groups and much more! Programs are available both in-person and virtually. The Art of Victorian Dining Put on your finest gown or tuxedo and take a step back in time to discuss the importance of dining in Victorian America.
